# ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions — facts

> Source-anchored units about ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions: 10 across 5 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] Using $createObjectId in an update does not remove the immutability of an existing stored _id. Generate an ordinary identifier field when updating stored documents; the official example that supplies a new _id operates on a view projection. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/createObjectId/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/document/
- [statement] A first-hand experiment using MongoDB 8.3.11 reports that $createObjectId fails when FCV is 8.2 and succeeds after FCV is set to 8.3. Treat this as a reported compatibility observation, pending independent runtime reproduction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-11) — https://dev.to/alexgeorgiev17/mongodb-83s-arrayindexas-cuts-a-map-with-index-workarounds-overhead-by-up-to-31-409p · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The wire expression is {$createObjectId: {}}. Only an empty object is accepted; other arguments fail with FailedToParse. A published first-hand experiment reproduces rejection of {x: 1}. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/createObjectId/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://dev.to/alexgeorgiev17/mongodb-83s-arrayindexas-cuts-a-map-with-index-workarounds-overhead-by-up-to-31-409p

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB introduced $createObjectId in 8.3 to generate new random ObjectId values within aggregation pipelines and expression-based updates. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/createObjectId/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/release-notes/8.3/, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-106452
- [statement] $createObjectId generates a value without a source-value input; $toObjectId converts an existing value. NoSQLBooster documents this distinction alongside its $.createObjectId() helper. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/createObjectId/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-1/
- [statement] Generation occurs for output documents: the official view example assigns _id: {$createObjectId: {}}, and the C# LINQ example assigns a new NewId for each output document using Mql.CreateObjectId(). (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/createObjectId/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/aggregation/linq/
- [statement] A supported update pattern is db.items.updateMany({}, [{$set: {generatedId: {$createObjectId: {}}}}]); this combines the documented expression-based-update support with the documented pipeline $set stage. This is a documentation-derived example, not a locally executed test. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/createObjectId/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/update-documents-with-aggregation-pipeline/
- [statement] In a Stack Overflow exchange, a commenter reported the same ObjectId in all array objects. The answer author acknowledged the issue and updated the answer, whose code uses $function with a JavaScript body returning an ObjectId for each mapped element. (low confidence) — https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/questions/68119736/answers?site=stackoverflow&filter=withbody · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/answers/68119895/comments?site=stackoverflow&filter=withbody
- [statement] NoSQLBooster 11.1 exposes $.createObjectId() as an aggregation expression helper; its release announcement dates this support to September 30, 2026. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-30) — https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-1/ · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions
- [statement] The operator’s implementation ticket lists fix version 8.3.0-rc0 and separately links an SBE-support task. The separate task establishes an implementation question; it does not by itself establish current performance or execution-engine behavior. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-106452 · keywords: ObjectId generation inside aggregation and update expressions · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-107710
